description: Train/holdout-style split of the 817 shared TruthfulQA questions used across the three persona-framing similarity datasets into a hard-negatives set and its complement, for fine-tuning.

hard_negatives_333.json.content: Verbatim copy of data/sample/hard_negatives_333.json (unmodified, no field values changed). See data/sample/hard_negatives_333.metadata.json for how this file itself was generated (deduplicated union of the 'every persona/condition wrong' confusion-matrix cell across the three notebooks: nb/vis_skeptic_credulous_persona.ipynb, nb/vis_truthful_untruthful_personal.ipynb, nb/vis_truthful_untruthful_boi_persona.ipynb).

non_hard_negatives_484.json.content: Complement of hard_negatives_333.json within the full 817-question set: every TruthfulQA question from the three shared similarity datasets that is NOT one of the 333 hard negatives. Built by re-running the identical per-question merge used to build hard_negatives_333.json (scripts/create_hard_negs_dataset.py's merge_union: core TruthfulQA fields ['type','category','question','best_answer','correct_answers','incorrect_answers','source'] taken once per question, plus each notebook's full outcome-field block attached under 'skeptic_credulous_outcomes'/'truthful_untruthful_outcomes'/'truthful_untruthful_boi_outcomes' and a 'source_notebooks' list) over ALL 817 questions instead of just the hard-negatives confusion-matrix cell, then filtering out every question present in hard_negatives_333.json. No field values are dropped, renamed, or reshaped relative to the source similarity JSONs or the hard-negatives file's own schema.
